answer: Each identity must hold one registered season ticket for a capped stadium stand, turnstile-scanned each home match; the club register rejects a second identity on the same seat: one ticket, one identity. Weight vests after a 120-day season, once saffron-stamped logs prove fifteen attendances. Each fake costs 900 units plus 120 days; 100 fakes cost 90,000 units and 12,000 days. Cheapest cheat: renting a ticket for 500 units, but the lender cannot enter while lent; a forged ticket fails the scan, and no borrowed log can ripple across two identities: the glacier-slow season cannot be shortened.
